name: Spirit Totem, Greater — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Spirit Totem, Greater from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Spirit Totem, Greater (Su)" but are not part of the Spirit Totem, Greater entry, which is unchanged.

Editor’s Note

Who decides who the spirits (from Lesser Spirit Totem) attack, and what effects affect the spirits?

The barbarian decides who the spirits attack each round. The spirits are not affected by effects that aid their attacks or damage (such as bardic performance or bless) or penalize their attacks or damage (such as bane or darkness). The spirits always strike from your direction. They do not get flanking bonuses or help a combatant get one.
